/dashboard/matches/[matchId] — the delivered breakdown.

Direction A folded into the page that exists: the rail stays, the three destinations stay, and the lede is added at the top of the Statistics pane.

Left: a match with film. Right: the same page for a SwingVision import, where the proof is points rather than clips.

Sketch fidelity — grey bars stand in for prose, figures are sample values.

Kept for the record.

Current — the three-tab report as it ships today.
B — lead with the court. C — lead with the film. D — lead with the numbers.

A was chosen; these are not being built.

Five takes on the 300px match rail, in the design system: ink ramp, one blue, Inter with Roboto Mono on machine values only (timestamps — never stats), borders for structure.

1 is the control. Each one after it moves a different thing: how the result reads, how much room the facts deserve, and whether the rail should carry a finding of its own.
